snippet.title: GRIMPS - Shoot Plush Monsters With a Hamster Shotgun | Demo Out Feb 3
snippet.description:
💥 GRIMPS is a chaotic first-person shooter where adorable plush monsters explode in clouds of buttons and stuffing.

🧪 Try the free demo now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297800/GRIMPS/
